canonical_queue.binding_basis: The six rendered titles match TP C01-C06 exactly; the TZ01 queue has a different title sequence, so images are bound to TP by title rather than upload order.

rejected_queue.reason: Its six titles describe a different plan (C01 starts 數位介入有訊號，但證據底座很小), so it is not the specification for these rendered images.

audit_policy.semantic_track: Check every result, outcome assignment, subgroup interpretation, clinical positioning and card-specific constraint against the PDF and the title-bound TP queue.
audit_policy.strict_render_track: Treat title, visible_text, allowed_visible_numbers and exact-once citation as the complete visible contract; scene descriptions authorise objects and layout but not added labels, legends, axes or treatment hierarchies.
global_constraints_checked: no claim that every OAB symptom improves
no ranking of digitally supervised support as proven best
no conversion of 6-13 weeks into an established optimal duration
no conversion of short-term attrition into long-term adherence
no assignment of the overall pooled SMD to the telemedicine subgroup
no attribution of a multicomponent effect to one digital ingredient
no replacement claim or invented first-, second- and third-line care hierarchy

summary.interpretation: C02, C04 and C05 preserve the source result semantics, while C01 is source-aligned but adds a legend and an unsupported certainty sentence. C03 mislabels the overall SMD as favouring telemedicine; C06 invents a three-line treatment pathway. Every card contains visible labels, axes or explanatory text outside the queue's exact visible_text contract.

cards.title: 數位介入治療膀胱過動症：先看證據底盤
visible_text: 共 7 項 RCT，544 人。
整體偏倚風險：5 項高風險，2 項有疑慮。
因試驗數少，未做正式發表偏倚檢驗。
小型證據庫與偏倚風險限制結論可信度。
標籤與框線表示內容功能；小標記表示證據狀態。
cards.main_visual_scene: 以研究證據堆疊與風險標記呈現一組數位照護工具，中央是膀胱與手機介面，旁邊以警示符號標示方法學限制。
cards.targeted_audit: fail on exact text, pass on source semantics: the five authorised lines are correct, but the card adds an uncertainty sentence and a four-item evidence-state legend.
cards.required_correction: 刪除『仍有不確定性，需更多高品質研究補足。』及核心／推論／缺口／衝突四項圖例定義，只保留核准文字與場景物件。

violations: The method panel adds the unlisted sentence 仍有不確定性，需更多高品質研究補足。
The complete 核心／推論／缺口／衝突 evidence-state definition legend is unlisted visible text, as are multiple phone and panel labels.

cards.title: 膀胱日誌：兩項改善，一項不確定
visible_text: 二十四小時排尿頻率：MD −2.55（−4.22 至 −0.89）
這些客觀結果只來自少數試驗，不能外推成所有症狀都改善。
cards.main_visual_scene: 以膀胱日誌作為中央物件，分成排尿頻率、急迫性尿失禁、夜尿三個並列結果模組，使用不帶因果的方向性符號與不確定性區間。

violations: The bladder-diary columns, clock times, axis labels and tick numbers are visible outside the exact visible_text and numeric contract.

cards.title: 主觀症狀：整體結果沒有過門檻
visible_text: 研究間差異很大：異質性 96%。
遠距照護的症狀效果接近對照；它的價值可能在可近性與照護效率。
症狀效果接近對照，不能解讀成遠距照護沒有臨床價值。
cards.main_visual_scene: 中央是一份主觀症狀問卷，旁邊以寬廣的不確定性帶呈現整體結果；另一側以視訊門診介面表示遠距照護，避免勝負排名。
cards.targeted_audit: fail: the central plot labels the pooled overall SMD as favouring telemedicine even though telemedicine is a separate near-zero subgroup; the questionnaire items and uncertainty sentence are also unlisted.
semantic_violations: 圖表把五項研究的整體 SMD −1.07 方向標為『較有利於遠距照護』，錯把總體合併結果指定給遠距照護子群；原文遠距照護子群為接近零效應。
cards.required_correction: 把中央方向改為『較有利於數位介入／較有利於對照』或取消組別方向，只呈現整體不顯著區間；刪除未列出的問卷細項與右下不確定性句。

violations: The questionnaire invents six unlisted item names and response-scale labels.
The plot adds unlisted headings, axis numbers, 無差異 and the incorrect 較有利於遠距照護 direction label.
The bottom-right uncertainty sentence is absent from visible_text.

cards.title: 生活品質改善，但別把退組率當依從性
visible_text: 退組率：RR 0.92（0.59 至 1.45），與對照沒有顯著差異。
短期退組率相近，不等於已證明長期依從性更好。
cards.main_visual_scene: 以生活品質量表與短期試驗留存圖示做左右對照，生活品質一側顯示改善方向，退組率一側顯示兩組相近；底部明確區分短期退組與長期依從性。

violations: Unlisted headings, group labels, scale labels and axis tick numbers are rendered beyond the exact visible_text and numeric contract.

cards.title: 「看起來最好」的子群，還不能當答案
visible_text: 生活品質的大效果量來自單一視訊監督皮拉提斯研究。
探索性結果：不能據此判定高強度數位監督優於其他模式。六至十三週是探索性訊號，不是已確立的最佳療程長度。單一研究的巨大效果量不能代表整個數位監督類別。
cards.main_visual_scene: 以兩個探索性分支呈現監督強度與介入長度，全部使用虛線框與警示標記，不做冠軍排名；旁邊放置單一視訊運動研究作為不可外推的例子。
cards.targeted_audit: fail on exact text, pass on source semantics because structure and axis labels were rendered as additional prose.
cards.required_correction: 刪除兩個『探索性分支』標題、單一研究例子標題與偏向實驗／偏向對照座標文字；讓虛線框與物件承擔結構。

violations: Unlisted structure labels identify two exploratory branches and a single video-exercise example.
The plots add unlisted 偏向實驗／偏向對照 and zero-axis labels.

cards.title: 臨床位置：可當工具，不是定案
visible_text: 數位介入可能改善部分客觀症狀與生活品質。
多元組合介入無法拆出是哪個數位元件造成效果。
還需要更大型、方法更嚴謹、追蹤更久的 RCT。
目前證據支持「可能有幫助」，不支持「已確立最佳數位治療」。
cards.main_visual_scene: 以一個臨床工具箱呈現手機、視訊、提醒與遠距支持，旁邊以缺口模組列出尚未回答的問題；不畫替代標準照護的箭頭。
cards.targeted_audit: fail: the card invents a first-, second- and third-line OAB treatment ladder and labels the basket as a configurable digital toolbox, none of which is authorised visible text or an evidence-tested pathway.
semantic_violations: 左側『第一線／第二線／第三線』階梯把保守治療、行為與藥物、進一步評估與治療排成原論文未提出也未驗證的治療分線框架。
cards.required_correction: 移除三線治療階梯與工具箱文字，只保留無階級的數位工具物件、四句核准結論及研究缺口；不要暗示已建立的臨床序列。

violations: The complete first-, second- and third-line ladder is unlisted visible text and an unsupported treatment hierarchy.
數位介入工具箱／可選擇・可搭配・可調整, 研究缺口, future-RCT labels and other module text are outside visible_text.
